findings.title: Context's `config` ignores the copy that gets the readable schedule_type
findings.body: `get_monitor_environment_context` copies `monitor.config` and replaces `schedule_type` with its display name (lines 160-162). Then it returns `monitor_environment.monitor.config` at line 168, so the local `config` is never used and the event's `monitor` context carries the raw integer `schedule_type`. `get_schedule_type_display` is `ScheduleType.get_name(self.config["schedule_type"])` (src/sentry/monitors/models.py:344). The serializer (src/sentry/monitors/serializers.py:240-242) does use its copy. This bug existed before the PR and came along with the moved code. Since the function now lives in its own module, this is a cheap moment to return `config`. Doing so changes the context payload, so a test that asserts on the context would need updating.

findings.title: Moved docstring has typos and an example the function never produces
findings.body: "humam readible" should read "human readable". The examples "2 missed check-ins, 1 timeout check-in and 1 error check-in were detected" and "A failed check-in was detected" don't match what the code returns. The code produces "2 missed, 1 timeout and 1 error check-ins detected" (line 150 and line 156), and its singular strings are status-specific, such as "A missed check-in was detected" (lines 123-127).
